newsitem.title: THAILAND: Bank of Thailand extends trade data release time.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Thailand extends trade data release time.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said it needs a two-month time lag time to release monthly trade, industrial production and investment figures so authorities have additional time to review and adjust the data.

A central bank statement received on Monday said the bank's previous practice of announcing early estimates of trade statistics had caused misunderstanding among people in the private sector who are not familiar with the way preliminary information is gathered.
Market analysts said the bank's decision stemmed from criticism that its trade and current account deficit figures this year missed earlier projections by wide margins.

The statement said the Bank of Thailand would not change its current month-end schedule of releasing money market, bank credit, balance of payments and international reserve figures with a shorter one-month time lag as the data can be gathered by the bank itself.
